bars.description: Movement III only: bars 1–180 once in written order. The selected MusicXML has no repeat signs or endings; the Tempo I return at bar 111 is written out.

endpoints.basis: Windows from source-pitch energy inspection of the cached recording (endpoint_peaks.py, work/borodin-quartet-2-notturno-0-12.png and the 515–547 s pitch-band table). The opening viola A3 / violin II C-sharp4–E4 eighth chord rises at about 0.45 s, before the cello's A4 entry; the broad first-pass window had selected a later 7.9 s recurrence of the same pitches. At the end, separate pitch bands show the bar-178 viola figure A4/B4/C-sharp5/B4/A4 at about 536.2/536.8/537.2/537.8/538.3 s and the bar-179 E5 at about 539.2 s; the final bar-180 viola A4 under the pause re-enters quietly at about 542.4–542.6 s. The strongest A4 rise at 536.38 s, chosen by the first broad pass, is the bar-178 A4, not the last score attack. Numerical and visual inspection only; no aural review is claimed.

provenance: OpenScore String Quartets releases its scores under CC0 (https://github.com/OpenScore/StringQuartets#license-and-acknowledgement). The MusicXML identification credits markpearse's transcription from the IMSLP file(s) at https://imslp.org/wiki/Special:ReverseLookup/644692 and carries rights 'OpenScore (CC0)'. No printed-edition imprint is asserted beyond that reference.

Select zero-based half-open MusicXML measure indices [603, 783) from every part: the 'III. Notturno' Andante heading through the bar before 'IV. Finale'. Inherited clefs, key and time signature carry into the first selected bar. The original MXL download remains unchanged.

Four source-defined instrument parts are retained, with every explicitly encoded subsidiary voice inside its staff. The converter omits the source's print-object="no" elements (violin I bar 52 and violin II bars 56/64 hidden voice-2 quarter notes beneath written trills; hidden voice-2 rests in bar 43), so only printed notes are timed. Voice labels identify score parts, not separated audio stems or MIDI patches.
